Name: FS - Wardrobe of Octopath Traveler II
Author: ease1219
Description:
[center][size=5]🐙2024.7.13 is the 6th anniversary of Octopath Traveler! 🎈
[/size]歧路旅人的六周年纪念日即将到来！[/center]

[size=3]To celebrate, I'm happy to release the beta version of my Octopath Traveler II appearance mod (based on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]), which could let you cosplay the characters in Octopath Traveler II! [/size]
[size=2]为了庆祝，我很高兴地宣布，在这里上传我制作的基于Fashion Sense的歧路旅人2外观模组！让你能够在游玩过程中cosplay歧路旅人2中的角色！

[/size][size=3]（⚠️Attention: This is the appearance mod of OT2. My previous mod is for OT1, the two mods are different.）[/size]
（注意：本mod是歧路旅人2的外观模组，我之前上传的mod是歧路旅人1的外观模组，两个模组并不一样。）

[size=3]But, as it is not totally completed, I wish you could be patient for possible updates! 🙏[/size]
[size=2]但是，它还是半成品，所以我希望大家可以耐心等待后续可能实施的更新！[/size]

[size=3]It is recommended to use following two FS mods at the same time:[/size]
使用本模组时，推荐同时使用以下两个FS模组：
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14154]Vanilla Pants and Skirts[/url]﻿：提供可染色的游戏原生裤子和裙子。
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15431]SH's Gloves and Sleeves Pack[/url]﻿：提供可染色的各种样式的手套和袖子。
[/list]
——
[size=3]If you are a fan of Octopath Traveler series, I recommend you also install my another mod: [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25987][size=3]Wardrobe of Octopath Traveler[/size]
[/url]如果你是歧路旅人系列的粉丝，我推荐同时安装我八方一代的外观模组共同使用！↑
——

[size=3]Here is the list of what this mod currently contains, but attention: this is only used for you to know the contents, the language I used for the mod is Mandarin, and the real names of the clothes are not the same as below![/size]
[size=2]下面是这个模组当前包含的内容，但是请注意：这个目录仅用于让您了解模组内的内容，模组使用的语言是简体中文，并且模组内服饰的真实名字不与列表内容完全一致！
